relationship_to_certified_v0_2: v0.3 is a single, minimal controller-only change on top of the certified/audited v0.2 mechanism: it adds a minimum-sample-size guard (MIN_N_TO_TRUST_B=10) so that frozen (ladder-eval) decisions only select variant B_ONE_PER_ORDER when the frozen learner state has at least 10 training observations for B in that regime; otherwise it falls back to A_FULL_O42 (O42's own unmodified behavior). The frozen learner state (learner_frozen.json), the runner, and all config/seed/opponent manifests are byte-identical to the certified v0.2 package (see hashes below, unchanged from v0.2's provenance_manifest.json). No retraining was performed. v0.2 itself is left intact and unmodified; see candidate/adaptive-v0.2-ladder-candidate (packaged 2026-09-13, hash-verified in artifacts/ladder_adaptive_v0.2_diagnostic_2026-09-13).

controller_adaptive_slice_v0.change_summary: Added MIN_N_TO_TRUST_B=10 constant and a guard in Learner.choose(): when frozen=True and the greedy/UCB1 pick is B_ONE_PER_ORDER but that regime's B sample count is below 10, fall back to A_FULL_O42. Regime definition, reward window, state_vector, UCB1 training-time formula, and all other logic are unchanged (verify via diff against v0.2 controller).

v0_3_change.hypothesis: The v0.2 frozen learner state has several regimes where B_ONE_PER_ORDER's empirical mean is estimated from very few (1-6) real games; frozen-eval selection is effectively plain greedy on these noisy means (UCB1's explore bonus is negligible once totals are fixed at eval time). This risks the deployed policy deviating from O42 in states where the evidence for B does not actually support that deviation.
v0_3_change.test_performed: Re-ran Learner.choose() over all 7 certified v0.2 regimes with frozen=True, comparing the pre-existing (v0.2) selection to the new MIN_N_TO_TRUST_B=10 guarded selection.
